answer.verdict: Stop SET-ing the open DMA tag qwc on every pk->cur store. Add it once inside terminatePacketBuilderState, addu of ((cur-tag)>>4)-1, which is what ELF sceGifPkTerminate and sceVif1PkTerminate do. AddGsAD and CloseGifTag then leave word0 alone, so a game-side ADD close yields 2 and 5, and a stubbed terminate still closes the tag.

facts.c: The only writer of an already-open DMA tag word is refreshPacketBuilderPendingCount. If pk+8!=0 and cur>tag it SETs bits 0-15 to ((cur-tag)>>4)-1 and keeps bits 16-31. Its only caller is writePacketBuilderCurrent.

writePacketBuilderCurrent is the cur store for terminate, reserve, align, openPacketGifTag, closePacketGifTag, sceGifPkAddGsAD, sceGifPkAddGsData, sceGifPkCnt, sceGifPkEnd, sceGifPkRef, sceGifPkRefLoadImage (497,505,537,554,571), sceVif1PkAddGsAD, sceVif1PkCall, sceVif1PkCnt, sceVif1PkEnd, sceVif1PkOpenDirectCode. reserve/align/open-gif/close-gif also cover sceGifPkReserve, sceVif1PkReserve, sceVif1PkAlign, sceGifPkOpenGifTag, sceVif1PkOpenGifTag, sceGifPkCloseGifTag (gif ptr pk+12), sceVif1PkCloseGifTag (gif ptr pk+20).

pk+8, the open-tag pointer, is stored by init/reset (0), terminate (0), sceGifPkCnt, sceGifPkEnd, sceGifPkRefLoadImage, sceVif1PkCnt, sceVif1PkEnd, sceVif1PkCall. sceGifPkRef does not point pk+8 at the REF tag; that qwc is the value in the tag word. sceVif1PkCloseDirectCode addu's the word at pk+12 (DIRECT immediate) and does not call refresh.

refresh and the test 'VIF1 packet builders keep chain qwc live before terminate' enter in 93e221feaa3b24b8d2a49c45be415b90e1b33df4 (Ranieri, 2026-04-04, Feature/runtime ecosystem refactor #107). Parent 553a902 has no sceVif1PkCnt. The commit message does not mention qwc. The test expects (word0&0xFFFF)==1 after Cnt+OpenDirect+Reserve(4)+CloseDirect and before any terminate, then kicks VIF1 DMA.
facts.ref: git log -S refreshPacketBuilderPendingCount; git blame GS.cpp:230-263; ps2xTest/src/ps2_memory_tests.cpp:1613-1656

facts.c: No sce*PkCloseDmaTag exists. The DMA-tag close on the stub list is sceGifPkTerminate and sceVif1PkTerminate, both terminatePacketBuilderState. sceGifPkCnt, sceGifPkEnd, sceGifPkRef, sceGifPkRefLoadImage, sceVif1PkCnt, sceVif1PkEnd, sceVif1PkCall close the previous tag by calling that first. CloseGifTag updates the GIF nloop. CloseDirectCode updates the DIRECT immediate.

Tekken toml stubs only five libpkt entries: sceGifPkCloseGifTag@0x292B28, sceGifPkAddGsAD@0x292BD0, sceVif1PkOpenDirectCode@0x292D78, sceVif1PkCloseGifTag@0x292E18, sceVif1PkAddGsAD@0x292F70. Terminate, Cnt, End and Ref are game code.

ELF sceVif1PkAddGsAD 0x292f70 (12 insns) loads pk+0, stores 16 bytes at cur, stores the new cur to pk+0. No pk+8. ELF sceGifPkAddGsAD 0x292bd0 is sd data, sd reg, sw pk+0. ELF sceVif1PkCloseGifTag 0x292e18 touches pk+20, pk+0 and the giftag. ELF sceGifPkCloseGifTag 0x292b28 is the same with pk+12. Neither CloseGif loads or stores pk+8.

0x292900 and 0x292c18 are one 88-byte function: pad while (cur&0xC), if pk+8!=0 then word0 += ((cur-tag)>>4)-1 via sra, addiu -1, addu of the whole word, then pk+8=0 and pk+0=cur. 0x292900 is GIF terminate, jal'd by 0x292970 CNT (lui 0x1000, 16-byte tag), 0x2929e8 REF (lui 0x3000), 0x292a80 END (lui 0x7000). 0x292c18 is VIF terminate, jal'd by 0x292c88 CNT (lui 0x1000, 8-byte tag) and 0x292ce0 REF (lui 0x3000). 0x292dd0 is CloseDirectCode: addu into pk+12, not the DMA word.

Fight shape cur=tag+0x30 (one GIF qword + one A+D qword) makes the ADD 2. A prior SET of 2 makes that ADD 4. Menu shape is a 16-byte GIF CNT plus one GIF qword plus four A+D qwords, cur=tag+0x60, ADD 5. A prior SET of 5 makes 10.
Upstream issue 374 describes this double count and the same fix: do not touch the DMA tag from the data stubs; compute qwc only in the stubbed close/terminate.

terminatePacketBuilderState does not add. It pads, calls writePacketBuilderCurrent (the SET), then stores 0 at pk+8. Stubbed terminate depends on that SET. Deleting refresh without an add there leaves stubbed-terminate games at the qwc written when the tag was opened, usually 0.
writeGuestU32 is defined at GS.cpp:202, after terminatePacketBuilderState at 140, and is not forward-declared. The new store has to use writeGuestBytes, which terminate already calls.
The Tekken workaround SETs qwc and is registered at 0x292900 and 0x292c18. It is not part of the upstream diff. With the opened low 16 equal to 0, that SET equals one ADD.

fix.change: BEFORE: void refreshPacketBuilderPendingCount(uint8_t *rdram, PS2Runtime *runtime, uint32_t stateAddr); AFTER: delete that forward declaration. Keep the writePacketBuilderCurrent declaration on the next line.
BEFORE: the whole refreshPacketBuilderPendingCount body (the masked SET). AFTER: delete it. No remaining caller.
BEFORE: writePacketBuilderCurrent writes cur then calls refreshPacketBuilderPendingCount. AFTER: writeGuestU32 of cur only. Delete the refresh call.

BEFORE: writePacketBuilderCurrent(...); writeGuestBytes pk+8 = 0; return currentAddr. AFTER, pad loop unchanged, zero already in scope: writePacketBuilderCurrent(...); uint32_t tagAddr=0; if (tryReadWordFromGuest(state+8) && tagAddr!=0 && tryReadWordFromGuest(tagAddr, word0)) { const int32_t qwcAdd=(static_cast<int32_t>(currentAddr-tagAddr)>>4)-1; word0=static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(word0)+qwcAdd); writeGuestBytes(tagAddr, &word0, 4); } then the existing writeGuestBytes of 0 to pk+8 and return currentAddr. This is the ELF addu at 0x292940 and 0x292c58, not a masked SET. tag==0 skips it, so a second terminate does not add. Do not edit closePacketGifTag's nloop add or sceVif1PkCloseDirectCode.

contra: ps2_memory_tests.cpp:1656 expects qwc==1 before terminate. This fix leaves that qwc at 0 until terminate, so the DMA kick in that test has to move to after sceVif1PkTerminate. The live SET is the bug.

refresh SETs bits 0-15 (GS.cpp:255). ELF terminate addu's the whole word (FUN_00292900.cpp:105-110). Opened low-16 of 0 and a qwc that fits in 16 bits: SET and ADD match. A Cnt/End/Call flag that already holds a qwc gets preload+count after this fix, and gets the count alone today.

VIF Cnt advances cur by 8 (FUN_00292c88.cpp:79-87; GS.cpp:1473). Closing that tag before any further qword: ELF and this fix add -1, so 0x10000000 becomes 0x0FFFFFFF. Today's refresh SETs the low 16 to 0 and keeps the CNT id, because deltaBytes<16 forces deltaQwords=0 (GS.cpp:250-253). The live test's cur is base+32, so it does not hit this.
